name: tagesschau
description: tagesschau.de is the ARD-aktuell German news site. This CLI searches news, lists top, ressort, regional, daily-archive and topic news, fetches full articles as JSON, and lists live streams.

commands.name: search-news
commands.summary: Full-text search of tagesschau news via the public api2u API. Returns stories with title, date, teaser and detail URLs, newest first.

commands.name: search-site
commands.summary: Website search with a media-type filter (article, video, audio, image gallery). Returns per-type counts and result items, newest first.

params.name: documentType
params.description: Restrict to one content type. If omitted, returns a short preview for every type.

params.name: pageIndex
params.description: Page index, 0-based. Only meaningful together with documentType.

commands.name: get-homepage-news
commands.summary: Current top news shown on the tagesschau.de homepage, as JSON.

commands.name: list-news
commands.summary: Latest news, optionally filtered by ressort (section) and German federal-state region(s).

params.name: regions
params.description: Federal-state region id(s), 1-16 (1=Baden-Württemberg … 16=Thüringen, alphabetical). Separate multiple ids with commas.

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Full article as JSON (text blocks, tags, images, video), looked up by its 3-segment web path ressort/subressort/slug.

params.name: ressort
params.description: First path segment of the article URL, e.g. wissen, inland, ausland, wirtschaft

params.name: subressort
params.description: Second path segment of the article URL, e.g. klima, europa, verbraucher

params.name: slug
params.description: Last path segment without .html, e.g. antarktis-eisschmelze-100. Take it from a shareURL or url. For a 4-segment regional path, use the 'details' URL from list/search results instead.

commands.name: list-channels
commands.summary: Live channels and streams (e.g. tagesschau24) with stream URLs.

commands.name: list-news-by-date
commands.summary: All news published on a given day, from the 7-day 'alle Meldungen' archive. Defaults to today.

params.name: datum
params.description: Date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, within roughly the last 7 days

commands.name: list-topic-news
commands.summary: Latest articles on a topic/tag page (e.g. ukraine, antarktis).

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic slug, lowercase, as in /thema/<topic> (also found in article 'about.sameAs' links)

notes: No login is needed. All commands are public reads.

To get an article as JSON, take its web URL, e.g. https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/innenpolitik/spd-wirft-cdu-sexismus-vor-100.html, strip the domain and '.html', and pass the rest to get-article as --path (inland/innenpolitik/spd-wirft-cdu-sexismus-vor-100). The 'details' field in api2u results is the ready-made JSON URL.
search-site: pageIndex is 0-based and only pages within a single documentType. sortBy=relevance returned 0 results, so results are always sorted newest first (dateTime_dt desc).
search-news (api2u) is 1-based (resultPage) and reports totalItemCount. Its counts differ from the website search (search-site).

list-news-by-date uses HTML selectors (teaser-right__*) based on tagesschau's known archive markup. The recorded outline only showed site chrome, so these selectors were not seen in the recording. The archive covers about the last 7 days.
The trailing-slash forms /api2u/homepage/ and /api2u/channels/ return a 308 redirect. Use the paths as given. /thema/<topic>/ also redirects to /thema/<topic>.
Article content blocks are in 'content' (type text/headline/box/video…). Text values contain HTML.
